fields.description: The PVE node name this guest lives on (e.g. what appears in /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/...). Populated by the poller; needed to build console (vncproxy/termproxy) API paths without re-discovering it per request.
fields.label: Proxmox Node

fields.description: At or above the Critical Threshold for the configured Confirmation Checks. Tracked for guests on every server role; the global recipient list is only notified for Production, see Alert Subscriptions for the per-instance override.
fields.label: Is Critical

fields.description: At or above the Warning Threshold for the configured Confirmation Checks, but below Critical. Tracked for guests on every server role.
fields.label: Is Warning

fields.description: Consecutive polls CPU/RAM/disk has stayed at-or-above the Warning Threshold. Cleared to 0 the moment a reading dips back below it.
fields.label: Warning Streak

fields.description: Consecutive polls CPU/RAM/disk has stayed at-or-above the Critical Threshold. Cleared to 0 the moment a reading dips back below it.
fields.label: Critical Streak

fields.description: LXC containers report this natively. QEMU VMs only report this if the QEMU guest agent is installed inside the VM — otherwise this stays blank.
fields.label: Disk Usage

fields.description: The most recent Success entry in Proxmox Backup Log for this guest, from either Local Disk or PBS Remote — whichever is newer.
fields.label: Last Successful Backup

fields.description: Best-effort, auto-populated from the QEMU guest agent / LXC network config where available.
fields.label: IP Address (auto)
Network Mode
fields.options:
Direct Public IP
Internal Bridge + Reverse Proxy

fields.description: Set manually — a directly-attached public IP or NAT/reverse-proxy mapping isn't always inferable from the Proxmox API alone.
fields.label: Public IP

fields.description: The Nginx Proxy Manager-fronted hostname you actually browse to, if any. Used by Phase 3 (Uptime Kuma monitoring).
fields.label: Access URL

fields.description: Manually assigned; never overwritten by the sync. Useful on Beta where one engineer may own several instances.
fields.label: Assigned Engineer
